A message from our Director

We've blended traditional recipes with modern processes, so every product reflects the values we hold dear: quality, trust and taste.
Mrs. Manju DeviDirector, Madhab Milk and Dairy House Agro Business Pvt. Ltd.
Read the full message

It brings me immense joy and pride to welcome you to Madhab Milk and Dairy House Agro Business Pvt. Ltd., a brand built on the foundations of family, flavour, and a relentless passion for baking excellence. Our journey began in 2020 in Sultanpur District, Uttar Pradesh. Today we run a large-scale, semi-automated factory in the heart of Purvanchal / Awadh, Uttar Pradesh. Guided by vision and hard work, we've blended traditional recipes with modern processes, ensuring that every product we offer reflects the values we hold dear: quality, trust, and taste. Today, Madhab is proud to serve not just our local communities, but also customers throughout India. As we continue to grow, innovate, and spread smiles, I thank you for being a part of our story. Your trust fuels our journey, and we look forward to baking many more memories together.
